name: unreal-agent
description: Run an external local Unreal Agent runner only on explicit request, then review its results in Codex. Not an Unreal Engine trigger.

interface.shortDescription: 명시적 요청으로 외부 Unreal Agent runner 실행 후 Codex 검토
interface.longDescription: Explicitly delegate a bounded task to the separately installed unreal-agent-runner, then inspect changes and evidence in Codex. Not a Codex execution mode or an automatic Unreal Engine workflow. No runner, credentials, MCP, app, or hooks are bundled.
defaultPrompt: $unreal-agent로 지정한 작업을 로컬 runner에서 수행하고 변경 사항과 검증 결과를 Codex에서 검토해주세요.
